Pokémon Trading Card Game Pocket lets you easily collect Pokémon cards. Creatures Inc. has created exciting new visual effects for cards that are only possible digitally. Pokémon cards, played with by people in 89 countries, are now closer to you than ever! Enjoy Pokémon cards anytime, anywhere, on your mobile device! ■ You can open packs every day to get cards! Collect cards every day! You can open two booster packs every day at no cost to collect Pokémon cards featuring heartwarming illustrations from the past as well as all-new cards exclusive to this game. ■ New Pokémon cards! Immersive cards, a brand-new kind of card, make their debut here! With new illustrations that have a 3D feel, immersive cards will make you feel like you’ve leapt into the world of the card’s illustration! ■ Trade cards with friends! You can trade certain cards with friends. Use the trade feature to collect even more cards! ■ Show off your collection! You can use binders or display boards to showcase your cards and share them with the world! ■ Casual battles—alone or with friends! You can enjoy casual battles during quick breaks in your day! Ranked matches are now available for players who'd like to battle even more.

Julie Julie Julie #IT155803 Member since 2025-01-28 1 Reviews Following 0 Topics 0 Users Follow Followed 0 Followers View 6 /10 I enjoyed it at first, but when I noticed that your percentage of actually getting a rare pack is so extremely low and the events are obviously being hacked by other players. For some reason the algorithm seems to always be against you, especially in the last event they had. I did write them a letter and say how can I get a card as common as a golem and yet my boyfriend has 16 of them Aunt. They ended up giving me like three of them the next day out of packs that I picked. I'm still amazed at how some people have five golden Muse and yet they say this game is fair whether you pay or don't pay. This is completely untrue because you can't get the best cards without using some money. So unless you have some really good strategy on beating some really good ex cards and getting doubles of everything then you'll never be able to win against some of these people no matter how much talent you think you have. Also, I can't wait for trading to actually be involved in this trading card game. I wasn't there when the game actually started but I do believe that people were selling cards for real money. I just got a message about it somebody's always got to ruin everything for everyone else. Hopefully they fix that. You don't need to buy cards off other people. You can get them and even without paying you can get some good cards. I do think there should be more involved in the monthly passes and the events need to be more lengthier more things to do. The last event which consisted of winning five battles in a row was totally set against you. It took me a week just to get two wins in a row and then after that I made it up to four wins in a row and I could never make it up to five five. I always got smashed by somebody and that somebody was a level 11 player. Made me think it was actually the computer or playing against one of the developers like it was made to make you lose.
